verses.sanskrit:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच।
              यदप्यल्पतरं कर्म तदप्येकेन दुष्करम्। पुरुषेणासहायेन किमु राज्ञा पितामह॥१॥
verses.english: Vyasa said Those who are well-read in the scriptures see, with the help of acts laid down in the scriptures, the Soul which is encased in a subtile body and is highly subtile and which is dissociated from the gross body in which it lives.

verses.sanskrit: किंशीलः किंसमाचारो राज्ञोऽथ सचिवो भवेत्। कीदृशे विश्वसेद्राजा कीदृशे न च विश्वसेत्॥२॥
verses.english: As the rays of the Sun which move in dense masses through every part of the sky, cannot be seen by the naked eye though their existence can be perceived by reason, likewise, existent beings freed from gross bodies and moving in universe are above the reach of human vision,

verses.sanskrit:
भीष्म उवाच।
              चतुर्विधानि मित्राणि राज्ञां राजन्भवन्त्युत। सहार्थो भजमानश्च सहजः कृत्रिमस्तथा॥३॥
verses.english: As the shining solar disc is seen reflected in the reflected water so the Yogin sees reflected within gross bodies the existent self.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मात्मा पञ्चमश्चापि मित्रं नैकस्य न द्वयोः। यतो धर्मस्ततो वा स्याद्धर्मस्थो वा ततो भवेत्॥४॥
verses.english: All those souls again that are encased in subtile forins after being alienated from the gross bodies in which they lived, are perceptible to Yogins, who have controlled their senses and who are gifted with knowledge of the soul. Indeed, helped by their own souls, Yogins see those invisible beings,

verses.sanskrit: यस्तस्यार्थो न रोचेत न तं तस्य प्रकाशयेत्। धर्माधर्मेण राजानश्चरन्ति विजिगीषवः॥५॥
verses.english: Whether asleep or awake, during the day or in the night, and during the night or in the day, they who practise Yoga after renouncing all the creations of the understanding the passion engendered by acts, and the power which Yoga begets, succeed in keeping their subtile form under complete control.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्णां मध्यमौ श्रेष्ठौ नित्यं शङ्क्यौ तथापरौ। सर्वे नित्यं शङ्कितव्याः प्रत्यक्षं कार्यमात्मनः॥६॥
verses.english: The individual soul which lives in such Yogins, always endued with the seven subtile principles, moves in all blissful regions, freed from decrepitude and death. I say “always,' and 'freed from death, as in common parlance, for, in sooth, that subtile form is also terininable.

verses.sanskrit: न हि राज्ञा प्रमादो वै कर्तव्यो मित्ररक्षणे। प्रमादिनं हि राजानं लोकाः परिभवन्त्युत॥७॥
verses.english: That man, however, who is under the influence of his mind and understanding, differentiates, even in his dreams, his own body from that of another and experiences both pleasure and pain.

verses.sanskrit: असाधुः साधुतामेति साधुर्भवति दारुणः। अरिश्च मित्रं भवति मित्रं चापि प्रदुष्यति॥८॥
verses.english: Really, even in his dreams he enjoys happiness and suffers misery; and yielding to anger and cupidity, suffers all sorts of calamities.

verses.sanskrit: अनित्यचित्तः पुरुषस्तस्मिन्को जातु विश्वसेत्। तस्मात्प्रधानं यत्कार्यं प्रत्यक्षं तत्समाचरेत्॥९॥
verses.english: In his dreams he acquires great riches and feels highly satisfied: performs meritorious acts, and sees as he does when he is awake.

verses.sanskrit: एकान्तेन हि विश्वासः कृत्स्नो धर्मार्थनाशकः। अविश्वासश्च सर्वत्र मृत्युना च विशिष्यते॥१०॥
verses.english: It is wonderful to mark that individual soul which has to lie within the uterus and amid much internal heat, and which has to pass there full ten months, is not digested and destroyed like food within the stomach.

verses.sanskrit: अकालमृत्युर्विश्वासो विश्वसन् हि विपद्यते। यस्मिन्करोति विश्वासमिच्छतस्तस्य जीवति॥११॥
verses.english: Men possessed by the qualities of Darkness and Ignorance never succeed in sceing within the gross body the sentiency which is a portion of the Supreme Soul to transcendent effulgence and which lies within the heart of every creature.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्विश्वसितव्यं च शङ्कितव्यं च केषुचित्। एषा नीतिगतिस्तात लक्ष्या चैव सनातनी॥१२॥
verses.english: They who learn Yoga for the purpose of obtaining a knowledge of Self succeed in getting over the inanimate and gross body, the imperceptible subtile body, and the casual body which is not destroyed on the occasion of even the universal destruction.

verses.sanskrit: यं मन्येत ममाभावादिममर्थागमं स्पृशेत्। नित्यं तस्माच्छङ्कितव्यममित्रं तद्विदुर्बुधाः॥१३॥
verses.english: Of the duties laid down for the various modes of life including the fourth mode, these which I have described, which have Yoga for their foremost, and which indicate a complete stoppage of all operations of the Mind and the Understanding, have been laid down by Shandilya.

verses.sanskrit: यस्य क्षेत्रादप्युदकं क्षेत्रमन्यस्य गच्छति। न तत्रानिच्छतस्तस्य भिघेरन्सर्वसेतवः॥१४॥
verses.english: Having comprehended the seven subtile principles, having comprehended also the Supreme Cause of the universe with the six attributes, and lastly having understood that the universe so only a modification of nescience endued with the three qualities, one succeeds in seeing high Brahina,

verses.sanskrit: तथैवात्युदकाद्भीतस्तस्य भेदनमिच्छति। यमेवं लक्षणं विद्यात्तममित्रं विनिर्दिशेत्॥१५॥
verses.english: Terrified with the fear of huge quantity of water that might fill up in the field, one who wants to break the ridge, he is said as enemy.

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु वृद्ध्या न तृप्येत क्षये दीनतरो भवेत्। एतदुत्तममित्रस्य निमित्तमिति चक्षते॥१६॥
verses.english: A person whose joy knows no limit upon seeing the advancement of the king and who feels pain upon seeing the king's decay, is one of the best friends of the king.

verses.sanskrit: यन्मन्येत ममाभावादस्याभावो भवेदिति। तस्मिन्कुर्वीत विश्वासं यथा पितरि वै तथा॥१७॥
verses.english: He who would meet with ruin by your fall, should be trusted by you completely even as you should trust your father. You should, to the best of your power, advance him as you secure advancement for yourself. One who, in even your religious rites, tries to save you from harm, would try to save you from harm in every other transaction. Such a one should be known as your best friend. They, on the other hand, who wish one harm are one's enemies.

verses.sanskrit: तं शक्त्या वर्धमानश्च सर्वतः परिबृंहयेत्। नित्यं क्षताद्वारयति यो धर्मेष्वपि कर्मसु॥१८॥
क्षताद्भीतं विजानीयादुत्तमं मित्रलक्षणम्। ये तस्य क्षतमिच्छन्ति ते तस्य रिपवः स्मृताः॥१९॥
व्यसनान्नित्यभीतो यः समृद्ध्या यो न दुष्यति। यत्स्यादेवंविधं मित्रं तदात्मसममुच्यते॥२०॥
verses.english: That friend is like your own self who is filled with fear when calamity befalls you and with joy when prosperity smiles on you.

verses.sanskrit: रूप-वर्ण-स्वरोपेतस्तितिक्षुरनसूयकः। कुलीनः कुलसम्पन्नः स तस्मात्प्रत्यनन्तरः॥२१॥
verses.english: A person endued with beauty, fair complexion, sweet voice, liberality, highmindedness, and good birth, cannot be such a friend.

verses.sanskrit: मेधावी स्मृतिमान्दक्षः प्रकृत्या चानृशंस्यवान्। यो मानितोऽमानितो वा न च दुष्येत्कदाचन॥२२॥
verses.english: That person who is endued with intelligence and memory, who is smart in transacting business, who is by nature shorn of cruelty, who is never wrathful, and who whether honoured or neglected is never dissatisfied, be he your priest or preceptor or trusted friend, should always receive your adoration if he accepts the office of your counsellor and lives in your palace.

verses.sanskrit: ऋत्विग्वा यदि वाऽऽचार्यः सखा वाऽत्यन्तसंस्तुतः। गृहे वसेदमात्यस्ते स स्यात्परमपूजितः॥२३॥
स ते विद्यात्परं मन्त्रं प्रकृतिं चार्थधर्मयोः। विश्वासस्ते भवेत्तत्र यथा पितरि वै तथा॥२४॥
verses.english: You may communicate to such a person your most secret counsels and the true state of never all your affairs, spiritual or temporal. You may trust him as you may your own father.

verses.sanskrit: नैव द्वौ न त्रयः कार्या न मृष्येरन् परस्परम्। एकार्थे ह्येव भूतानां भेदो भवति सर्वदा॥२५॥
verses.english: One person should be appointed to one work, and not two or three. These may not tolerate each other. It is always seen that several persons, if engaged in one and the same work, disagree with one another.

verses.sanskrit: कीर्तिप्रधानो यस्तु स्याद्यश्च स्यात्समये स्थितः। समर्थान् यश्च न द्वेष्टि नानर्थान्कुरुते च यः॥२६॥
verses.english: That person who acquires fame, who observes all restraints, who is never jealous of able and competent persons, who never does any evil act, who renounces righteousness from lust or fear or covetousness or wrath, who is smart in transaction business, and who always speaks wise and weighty words, should be your foremost of ministers.

verses.sanskrit: यो न कामाद्भयाल्लोभात् क्रोधाद्वा धर्ममुत्सृजेत्। दक्षः पर्याप्तवचनः स ते स्यात्प्रत्यनन्तरः॥२७॥
कुलीनः शीलसम्पन्नस्तितिक्षुरविकत्थनः। शूरश्चार्यश्च विद्वांश्च प्रतिपत्तिविशारदः॥२८॥
verses.english: Well-behaved persons and born in good families, who are liberal and never given to brag, who are brave and respectable, and learned and full of resources, should be appointed as ministers for supervising all your affairs. Respected by you and gratified with riches, they would act for your well-being and be of great help to you.

verses.sanskrit: एते ह्यमात्याः कर्तव्याः सर्वकर्मस्ववस्थिताः। पूजिताः संविभक्ताश्च सुसहायाः स्वनुष्ठिताः॥२९॥
कृत्स्नमेते विनिक्षिप्ताः प्रतिरूपेषु कर्मसु। युक्ता महत्सु कार्येषु श्रेयांस्युत्थापयन्त्युत॥३०॥
verses.english: Appointed of offices of emolument and of other important matters, they will always secure great prosperity.

verses.sanskrit: एते कर्माणि कुर्वन्ति स्पर्धमाना मिथः सदा। अनुतिष्ठन्ति चैवार्थमाचक्षाणाः परस्परम्॥३१॥
verses.english: Actuated by a feeling of healthy rivalry, they satisfy all duties regarding profit, consulting with one another when necessary.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञातिभ्यश्चैव बुद्ध्येथा मृत्योरिव भयं सदा। उपराजेव राजर्धि ज्ञातिर्न सहते सदा॥३२॥
verses.english: You should fear your kinsmen as you should death itself. A kinsman can never bear a kinsmen's prosperity even as a feudatory chief cannot bear to see the prosperity of his lord.

verses.sanskrit: ऋजोर्मृदोर्वदान्यस्य ह्रीमतः सत्यवादिनः। नान्यो ज्ञातेर्महाबाहो विनाशमभिनन्दति॥३३॥
verses.english: None but a kinsman feels joy at the destruction of a kinsman endued with sincerity, mildness, liberality, modesty and truthfulness.

verses.sanskrit: अज्ञातिनोऽपि न सुखा नावज्ञेयास्ततः परम्। अज्ञातिमन्तं पुरुषं परे चाभिभवन्त्युत॥३४॥
verses.english: They, again, who have no kinsmen, can not be happy. No man is more contemptible than he who has no kinsman. A person who has no kinsman is easily overthrown by enemies.

verses.sanskrit: निकृतस्य नरैरन्यैर्ज्ञातिरेव परायणम्। नान्यो निकारं सहते ज्ञातिर्ज्ञातेः कथञ्चन॥३५॥
verses.english: Kinsmen are the refuge of one who is attacked by others, for kinsmen can never bear to see a kinsman assailed by other people.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मानमेव जानाति निकृतं बान्धवैरपि। तेषु सन्ति गुणाश्चैव नैर्गुण्यं चैव लक्ष्यते॥३६॥
verses.english: When a kinsman is persecuted by even his friends, every kinsman of his considers the injury to be inflicted upon himself. In kinsmen, therefore, there both merits and shortcomings. A person having no kinsmen never shows favours to any one nor humbles himself to any one. In kinsmen, therefore, both mcrit and demerit are seen.

verses.sanskrit: नाज्ञातिरनुगृह्णाति न चाज्ञातिर्नमस्यति। उभयं ज्ञातिवर्गेषु दृश्यते साध्वसाधु च॥३७॥
सम्मानयेत्पूजयेच्च वाचा नित्यं च कर्मणा। कुर्याच्च प्रियमेतेभ्यो नाप्रियं किञ्चिदाचरेत्॥३८॥
विश्वस्तवदविश्वस्तस्तेषु वर्तेत सर्वदा। न हि दोषा गुणो वेति निरूप्यस्तेषु दृश्यते॥३९॥
verses.english: Though one may mistrust them at heart, he should behave towards them as if he trusted them completely. Thinking of their nature, it seems that they have neither demerits nor merits.

verses.sanskrit: अस्यैवं वर्तमानस्य पुरुषस्याप्रमादिनः। अमित्राः संप्रसीदन्ति तथा मित्रीभवन्त्यपि॥४०॥
य एवं वर्तते नित्यं ज्ञातिसम्बन्धिमण्डले। मित्रेष्वमित्रे मध्यस्थे चिरं यशसि तिष्ठति॥४१॥
verses.english: One who always conducts himself in this way with his kinsmen and relatives and treats thus his friends and enemies, succeeds in acquiring everlasting fame.'
